features.name: App Routing
features.description: SPA routing across login, dashboard, contracts, create contract, contract detail, profile, search, user profile, analytics, settings, help, and not found pages

features.name: Authentication Store
features.description: Zustand store for current user management and logout functionality

features.name: Mock Data Client
features.description: LocalStorage-backed client for users, contracts, extensions, reviews, and reminders with full CRUD operations

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Comprehensive overview with loan requests, extension requests, active metrics, actions, payment proof workflows, and borrower/lender sections

features.name: Create Contract
features.description: Form to request a loan with lender phone, amount, reason, date+time pickers, and validation

features.name: Contract Detail
features.description: Detailed view with Accept/Reject (lender), Ask for Extension/Settle Up (borrower), and proof viewer

features.name: Contracts List
features.description: Tabbed list of all, active, settled contracts with reusable ContractCard actions

features.name: Profiles and Search
features.description: User profile pages (borrower/lender), search profiles, and user switcher functionality

features.name: Payment Proof System
features.description: Upload and validate payment proofs for disbursal and settlement with image preview and validation

features.name: Contract Management
features.description: Extension requests, settlement dialogs, and contract status management

features.name: Review System
features.description: Rate and review borrowers with reliability score calculation and display

features.name: UI Components
features.description: Reusable UI components including mobile header, invite dialog, and status badges

features.name: Additional Pages
features.description: Analytics, settings, help pages for comprehensive app functionality

features.name: PWA Features
features.description: Progressive Web App with manifest, service worker, mobile-first design, and app-like experience

features.name: Data Utilities
features.description: Utility functions for formatting, reliability calculation, and data management

features.name: Hooks
features.description: Custom React hooks for mobile detection and toast notifications
